exposure: Trial of labor resulting in vaginal delivery
trial of labor resulting in CD (TOL-CD)
Trial of labor resulting in cesarean delivery
cohort: 1865 women who had received a kidney or liver transplant and had a live birth at or later than 20 weeks' gestational age between 1968 and 2019
finding: Trial of labor compared to scheduled cesarean delivery was associated with improved neonatal outcomes among kidney and liver transplant recipients and not associated with increased severe maternal morbidity among kidney transplant recipients.
mod_finding: Trial of labor resulting in either cesarean or vaginal delivery was associated with a decrease in neonatal composite morbidity among kidney transplant recipients and with a decrease in neonatal composite morbidity among liver transplant recipients who underwent trial of labor resulting in vaginal delivery but not cesarean delivery.
